name: kids-story-studio
description: Pip and the Missing Glow: a 135-second animated short drawn entirely by code (Canvas 2D), with a guide to building it with AI coding agents.

scripts.trailer: node film/render.mjs --page trailer.html --out out/trailer-picture.mp4 --cues out/trailer-cues.json && python3 film/sound/trailer.py out/trailer-cues.json out/trailer-score.wav --picture out/trailer-picture.mp4 --out out/trailer.mp4
scripts.trailer:es: node film/render.mjs --page 'trailer.html?lang=es' --out out/trailer-picture-es.mp4 --cues out/trailer-cues-es.json && python3 film/sound/trailer.py out/trailer-cues-es.json out/trailer-score-es.wav --picture out/trailer-picture-es.mp4 --out out/trailer-es.mp4
